title: Gulf: attacks spread beyond the Strait | 12 Oct
notes:
The Gulf tanker war widened over the weekend and crude rose. Brent hit $106.80, up $2.09, and WTI hit $93.78, up $1.93. Early Monday the Russia-Ukraine "energy ceasefire" had pulled prices lower, but the Middle East attacks outweighed it by the US session. European gas is at its highest since early 2023.

title: Hormuz: 11 October count revised to six ships hit | 13 Oct
